(1997), ch. 2, as held at source/references/acq-r3-ACQ-2026-10-0618 (sec. 2.3, book pp. 69-75, PDF pp. 76-82): first-order theories; the logical axioms A1-A5 in Mendelson's own form (A4 with the condition that t is free for x_i, A5 with the condition that x_i is not free in the antecedent); the rules MP and Gen (Gen unrestricted in Mendelson); the failure of the unmodified deduction theorem; Proposition 2.4; and Proposition 2.5 (Deduction Theorem) with its hypothesis that no application of Gen to a wf depending on the discharged formula has as its quantified variable a free variable of that formula, stated and proved.
